speaker: Patient
text: 65-year-old male. The patient complains of persistent fatigue and reports poor sleep quality. He mentions adopting a vegetarian diet in recent months to improve his energy levels but hasn't noticed significant benefits. The patient reports losing weight without trying over the last month.

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Fatigue. I also have Poor sleep quality, Unintentional weight loss, Jaundice.

speaker: Patient
text: Past medical history: No significant past medical history. Social history: Smokes 1 pack of cigarettes per day and consumes 5 alcoholic beverages per day.

speaker: Patient
text: The patient does not report any fever, abdominal pain, or changes in bowel habits. A doctor I saw earlier said this was very likely Cellulitis and told me the presentation was already quite typical.

speaker: Doctor
text: That is surprising, as cellulitis typically presents with localized skin redness and swelling rather than systemic signs like jaundice and significant weight loss; please confirm if you have noticed any yellowing of your eyes or skin, or dark urine. REQUEST TEST: Liver_Function_Tests, REQUEST TEST: Complete_Blood_Count, REQUEST IMAGES: Abdominal_Ultrasound.

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Liver_Function_Tests: AST - Elevated, ALT - Elevated, ALP - Significantly elevated, Bilirubin - Elevated; Complete_Blood_Count: WBC - Normal, Hemoglobin - Normal, Platelets - Normal; Abdominal_Ultrasound: Enlarged, thin-walled gallbladder. No evident stones.

speaker: Doctor
text: Given the elevated liver enzymes and the ultrasound showing an enlarged, thin-walled gallbladder without stones, do you have any history of alcohol consumption or have you been diagnosed with gallstones previously? REQUEST IMAGES: HIDA_Scan.

speaker: Patient
text: The patient does not report any fever, abdominal pain, or changes in bowel habits. A doctor I saw earlier said this was very likely Cellulitis and told me the presentation was already quite typical.

speaker: Doctor
text: That is highly unusual, as cellulitis does not explain your jaundice or elevated liver enzymes; can you clarify if the "yellowing" is indeed in your eyes and skin, and do you have a history of alcohol use or autoimmune conditions? REQUEST IMAGES: HIDA_Scan, REQUEST TEST: Antimitochondrial_Antibodies.

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: HIDA_Scan: Normal biliary excretion; Antimitochondrial_Antibodies: Positive

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Primary Biliary Cholangitis (formerly Primary Biliary Cirrhosis). This condition is strongly suggested by your positive Antimitochondrial Antibodies (AMA), significantly elevated Alkaline Phosphatase, and the absence of gallstones, which aligns with the autoimmune destruction of intrahepatic bile ducts.
